_comment: Local agent presets for the chat panel's LOCAL AGENTS group.
WHY THIS IS DATA: agent CLIs change their flags faster than a plugin ships. A
hardcoded '--experimental-acp' is wrong the day it moves, and the failure mode
is an agent that will not start with no way for the user to fix it. Editing this
file is a one-line fix; a new agent nobody has heard of yet needs no plugin
update at all.
User overrides live in <Project>/Saved/UnrealMCPChat/agents.json and win over
this file by 'id', so a plugin update never clobbers a hand-added agent.
Fields:
id             stable key, also the folder name under Saved/UnrealMCPChat/agents/
display        what the model picker shows
command        binary name (resolved on PATH) or an absolute path
args           argument list, already split — quoting rules differ per platform
and one giant argument fails silently
env            environment variables applied around the spawn
mcpInjection   flag | env | manual | none — how the agent is told about our
MCP endpoint, which is what gives it all 450 editor tools
mcpConfigFlag  the flag ('--mcp-config') or the variable name, per mcpInjection
installHint    shown when the binary is missing
notes          shown before launch so the user knows what will actually run
models         models this agent can be pointed at. ACP does not report an
agent's model list, so it is data here. Empty = the agent
decides, which the picker says out loud.
modelEnvVar    pass the chosen model as an environment variable
modelArgFlag   ...or as a command-line flag. Only one is used.
Changing model RESTARTS the agent — neither reaches a running
process — so its conversation state starts fresh.

agents.installHint: Install Claude Code: npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, then sign in with 'claude'.
agents.notes: Runs through the ACP adapter. Uses your existing Claude Code subscription — no API key needed.

agents.installHint: Install Gemini CLI: npm i -g @google/gemini-cli, then run 'gemini' once to sign in.
Install Codex: npm i -g @openai/codex, then run 'codex' once to sign in.
agents.notes: Runs through the ACP adapter. Codex also exposes a native app-server; that backend is optional and not built yet.

agents.installHint: Install Kimi CLI and sign in with 'kimi'.
No install needed — npx fetches it on first run.
agents.notes: Native ACP mode. OpenCode also has an HTTP server mode; not used here.

agents.installHint: Install iFlow CLI and sign in once before using it here.
Copy this entry into Saved/UnrealMCPChat/agents.json, give it a new id, and fill in 'command' and 'args'.
agents.notes: Template. Any ACP-speaking binary works: the panel spawns it, speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, and hands it our MCP endpoint.
